title.zh: 阿玛尔纳大阿顿神庙塔拉塔特石块（大都会 21.9.8）
title.en: Talatat with offerings, Great Temple of the Aten, Amarna (Met 21.9.8)

caption.zh: 石灰岩塔拉塔特石块「神庙中的供品」，新王国第十八王朝阿肯那顿时期（约前 1347–1330 年）；出自阿玛尔纳大阿顿神庙南墙外坑，Petrie/Carter 1891–92 年发掘。大都会艺术博物馆藏，馆藏号 21.9.8。
caption.en: Limestone talatat 'Talatat with Offerings in the Temple', New Kingdom, Dynasty 18, reign of Akhenaten (ca. 1347–1330 BCE); from Amarna, Great Temple of the Aten, pit outside southern wall, Petrie/Carter excavations 1891–92. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, accession 21.9.8.
